svg.title: Inside one conversation: six state variables
svg.desc: Six modulator curves from OpenRook's deterministic emotional engine evaluating an authored 90-minute rupture-and-repair event sequence (illustrative dialogue, no LLM). Arousal jumps to 0.88 at the rupture and is back near baseline within minutes; valence falls from 0.78 to 0.30, drifts up only to 0.41 over the next half hour, then rises to 0.58 at the repair; bonding dips from 0.64 to 0.54 and later returns to 0.62; unresolved tension starts at 0.76, declines only to 0.74, and the repair clears it.
svg.text: Each line is an internal state variable.
“I think I was too harsh earlier.”
Authored event sequence evaluated by the real deterministic engine (shipped config/modulators.yaml).
Dialogue is illustrative; no LLM. Emotion words are the engine's logging heuristic: functional state, not a claim of felt emotion.
